content.text: {"summary":"Read the linear v-response off the weights. The q/v/u pairs (units 0/6 and 3/7) act almost linearly. The remaining small units contribute minor slopes. Units 10 and 11 shape the piecewise velocity response. The net velocity response is about -0.52·v near v=0, steepening to about -0.66 and -0.74 at larger |v|. A least-squares fit of -c·v - a·v|v| on the domain gives c ≈ 0.46 and a ≈ 0.13. This is an estimate, not a check. To subtract an extra c·v, I used unused hidden unit 2 as an always-active unit, z = v + 1, which stays non-negative on [-1,1]. Its output weight is -0.46, and b2 is raised by 0.46 to cancel the constant term. All other behaviour is unchanged.","estimated_c":0.46,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[2,1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"b1","index":[2],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[2],"value":-0.46},{"tensor":"b2","index":[0],"value":0.50435454}]}
